13be515e46a6.summary_en: NME ’s latest stars of The Cover , Radio Free Alice , have created an exclusive playlist to accompany the story’s launch – check it out below. READ MORE: Radio Free Alice are ready to take on the world The Australian indie band are on this week’s (October 19) edition of The Cover , a manifestation of NME ’s commitment to supporting emerging talent across the globe on a weekly basis. Every week, a rising artist will feature on The Cover – you can read Radio Free Alice’s profile here , written by Jordan Bassett and featuring photography by Tom Oxley. The four-piece have curated an exclusive playlist to accompany their appearance on The Cover , titled ‘Melbourne Friends’. The collection features artists from their local scene, including Dumbhead, Rain Dogs, HighSchool , former The Cover stars The Belair Lip Bombs , and more. Listen to the full playlist on Spotify below and on Apple Music . Radio Free Alice are set to release their debut album ‘What’s In Between’ on October 30, and in The Cover , they discuss their path to their first album – a journey that started when frontman Noah Learmonth and guitarist Jules Paradiso met as teenagers. “When you’re 14, 15, having someone that you can freely play music with or fuck around with is so important and exciting, as opposed to just doing it yourself,” Paradiso recalls of when the pair first started collaborating. “After a few years of doing it together, you start to realise: ‘Oh, shit, OK – maybe there’s a little nugget of something that we can actually move forward with.’” The band have evolved into an ambitious prospect – one that isn’t afraid to really go for their goals. “There’s a lot of people who don’t want to say they wanna be a really big band and then not be a big band and feel awkward about it,” explains Learmonth. “But then, as a result, no one manifests it, and everyone’s just making cassette tapes played in share houses to hipsters, so they’re not getting big. 481354eee48b.summary_en: マンチェスターのアート・ポップ・バンド Dutch Uncles が、2023年の『True Entertainment』以来となるニュー・アルバム『 Polygon Hotel 』を2027年初めに Memphis Industries からリリースする。そのあいだにはベーシストでありメイン・コンポーザーでもある Robin Richards がソロ・デビュー作『Taproots』を発表していたが、バンドとしても新たな一歩を踏み出していて、長年のコラボレーターだったマルチ奏者の Henry Broadhead とギタリストの Neil Wright が正式メンバーに加わり、6人組となって初めてのアルバムになる。 プロデュースはバンド自身が手がけ、ミックスには Geese や Lime Hotel との仕事で知られる Felix Davis を迎えている。「Outset I」で幕を開け、途中に「Outset II」を挟みながら「Chosen」で締めくくられる全11曲の構成からも、ひとつのホテルの中をあちこち巡っていくような、遊び心と構築美が同居したアルバムになりそうな予感がする。変拍子や細やかなアレンジを軽やかなポップに落とし込んできた彼らが、6人編成でどこまで音を広げてくるのか楽しみだ。 先行シングルの「No Note」は、XTC や Tears For Fears の遺伝子を感じさせる、マリンバがたっぷり鳴り響く賑やかで凝ったアレンジの一曲。メロディもあちこちへと思いがけない方向に転がっていく。ヴォーカルの Duncan Wallis によれば、スマホを眺めて無駄にしてしまう時間、とくにソーシャル・メディアに人生の多くを注ぎ込み、それが最悪の人たちに握られてしまったことへの後悔を歌った3分間の哀歌なのだそうだ。それなのに歌詞を書くのにかかったのはたった5分だったというのが、なんとも皮肉で彼ららしい。Patrick King が監督し、Miles Buckle が悪夢のような90年代風 CGI アニメーションを手がけたビデオもあわせて公開されている。
481354eee48b.summary_ru: Манчестерская арт-поп группа Dutch Uncles выпустит новый альбом Polygon Hotel на Memphis Industries в начале 2027 года, первый с шестиместным составом; вышел также сингл No Note с видео режиссёра Patrick King. Альбом спродюсирован группой, микс сделал Felix Davis (Geese, Lime Hotel), 11 треков.
481354eee48b.title: 6人組になって初めてのアルバムは、遊び心と構築美が詰まったホテル。マンチェスターのDutch Uncles、セルフ・プロデュースのニュー・アルバム『Polygon Hotel』をMemphis Industriesからリリース、先行シングル「No Note」を公開

5d249739af36.summary_en: The UK’s social climate has changed a lot since Skepta ‘s last album, 2019’s ‘Ignorance Is Bliss’ . Even in the 33 months since the titan of British rap music first teased ‘The Fork And Knife’ with the single ‘Gas Me Up’ in January 2024, hostility towards immigrants and minorities has surged from fringe to mainstream, reflected by the success of right-wing electoral forces like Reform UK. Ever self-reflective, he digs into childhood confrontations ( “Adenuga, what kind of name is that?” pipes a skit on ‘Secrets Of Patriarchy’), charts seismic social change (“It was ‘no blacks, no dogs, no Irish’ / Now it’s ‘Excuse me, can I help you sir?'” he raps on ‘Currency’) and enlists two-tone pioneer Suggs for ‘Innocent Smile’, an urgent, punk-ish breakbeat rhythm where he vents: “The way that we’re living is wild / Ain’t no love for an immigrant child… MPs lie, they treat us like idiots / How you turn around and blame it on immigrants?” These moments show that Skepta understands his responsibility as an elder of British rap. Still, the tighter, more cohesive structure that underpinned the brilliance of his Mercury Prize-winning mainstream breakthrough ‘Konnichiwa’ is missing. 61d0cae1406c.summary_en: Cage The Elephant have announced full details of their new album ‘Dying In Reverse’ and shared its latest taster ‘Make It Easy’ – check it out below. READ MORE: Cage The Elephant’s Matt Shultz: “I was in psychosis for three years – my arrest was a miracle” Their upcoming seventh album is set to be released on February 5, 2027 via Big Loud Rock. You can pre-order it here . The band shared the title track from their record back in September following the single ‘ Beaches In Tennessee ’. Now, they have shared the latest taster from their new album ‘Make It Easy’, check it out below. “This record’s turned out to be such a special one for us. Without doubt, one of the most creatively gratifying experiences we’ve had as a group yet. After all these years already remaining so tightly knit, it really does feel like this album managed to pull us even closer together,” said frontman Matthew Shultz. “In a way, it’s a goodbye to the past, closing the door on an era, with a renewed perspective grounded in the present while also walking towards the future with hope and gratitude. Signifying a rebirth of sorts. It’s got all these interesting little windows into the memories and experiences that have shaped who we are as individuals, as well as ultimately a band. I just love it so much. We can’t wait to share it with the world.” ‘Dying In Reverse’ artwork Last year, the band completed their run as special guests on Oasis’ ‘Live ’25 tour’ and went straight back into the studio to record the album. “The Oasis tour really reignited our fire to dream and continue to dream,” Schultz said. “I think we realised there’s still room to evolve and push ourselves, especially in the live realm. That tour added to our overall passion and desire to see this thing through. When it was over, we decided not to take a break… We pretty much went straight into the studio to start making music.” Shultz had been detained in a hotel in 2023 for carrying firearms which were only licenced in Kentucky and Tennessee. The arrest, a court found , was the result of psychotic delusions which Shultz had been suffering from as a side-effect of medication he’d been prescribed. “The arrest, without a doubt, was a miracle,” he told NME in 2024 . “It saved my life. Following the arrest I was hospitalised for two months. Then I had six months of outpatient therapy afterwards and I feel completely recovered. But obviously, with recovery, it’s a lifelong thing. You don’t experience something like that and not deal with the scars for the rest of your life, I’m sure.” Describing how this new music marks a “new chapter” for Cage The Elephant, the singer recently shared: “Musically, we always want to reinvent Cage The Elephant. We’ve discovered a whole new side to our band, how we look at things, and how we make art. You’re growing constantly as an artist, and I think we’ve tapped into that growth. I do feel like we’re making the best music we’ve ever made. If anything, it’s definitely the most inspired.”

Back to Black — второй и последний студийный альбом британской певицы Эми Уайнхаус , выпущенный 27 октября 2006 года. Написанный под влиянием болезненного расставания с Блейком Филдер-Сивилом, альбом исследует темы разбитого сердца, измены, вины и трагедии в отношениях. Музыкально пластинка вдохновлена девичьими поп- и соул-группами 1960-х годов в сочетании с современным R&B и нео-соулом, над чем певица работала с продюсерами Марком Ронсоном и Салаамом Реми . В альбом вошли такие культовые синглы, как «Rehab», «You Know I'm No Good» и «Back to Black». Релиз принёс Уайнхаус всемирное признание и пять премий «Грэмми» на одной церемонии 2008 года. Зафиксировав статус Эми как культурной иконы и дав мощный толчок популярности британского соула, «Back to Black» вошёл в списки величайших альбомов всех времён и был внесён в Библиотеку Конгресса США. In response, Noel said, “16 years”, referring to the gap between Oasis’ split and their 2025 reunion tour . “When you revive [ Chicken Shop Date ], get me back on.” Dimoldenberg fired back: “Well, you might not be around.” Noel replied: “In 16 years? He responded: “You’ve just got to hope that you can do whatever it is you’re trying to do as well as you once did it. And in the case of Oasis, it became apparent after maybe a week in rehearsals that it was gonna be as good, if not better, than it ever was.” As for his advice for working alongside a brother or sister, he said: “I think you’ve got to be prepared just to compromise, which is something I’m not ordinarily very good at. But I think it gets better as you get older.” Gallagher teased that he has “tonnes of unreleased material”, too, but did not say whether this was for Oasis. The musician revealed how his perception of Oasis’ Live ’25 closer ‘Champagne Supernova’ had changed over the years: “It was nonsensical in the ’90s, and then it’s taken on more meaning for a new generation. Inputs are fed through Pilia’s chain of filters and tape echo and on into Salogni’s Revox reel-to-reel tape machine for further manipulation and modulation, the signals absorbing new layers and mutations as they go. d91c3cdb6d9e.summary_en: Amo Amo として活動するパフォーマー Love Femme と、幽玄なピアノで知られる作曲家 Nico Georis が、初めての共作フル・アルバム『 Wildwife Wildlife 』を2027年初めに Leaving Records からリリースする。メキシコのチワワに生まれ、主にエルパソで育った Femme は、10人きょうだいの真ん中として牧場で馬に乗り、銃の撃ち方を覚えたような子ども時代を過ごし、20代前半にはニューヨークの実験劇団 Living Theatre にも身を置いていた。一方の Georis は、映画『Endless Summer』の音楽を手がけた The Sandals のメンバーを父に持ち、カリフォルニアのセントラル・コーストからパリ、サンフランシスコ、ニューヨークのアンダーグラウンドを渡り歩き、近年はデス・ヴァレーのコスミッシェとでも呼びたくなるポスト・クラシカルな作品を Leaving から発表してきた。互いに同じ魂の持ち主だと感じたふたりは、行き場をなくした曲をそれぞれ抱えて砂漠へと移り住んだのだという。 数年をかけて作られた今作は、デス・ヴァレーとバハ・カリフォルニアで書かれ、録音されたもので、ミックスには Shahzad Ismaily も加わっている。イルカの頭蓋骨にウニの棘を詰めたシェイカーまで転がる、世紀末に建てられた古いダンスホールで録音されたアルバムは、パーティー・レコードであり、死や弔い、相互依存をめぐる瞑想であり、録音された砂漠の町へのオマージュでもあるそうだ。「happy wife, happy life」という決まり文句をもじったタイトルとは裏腹に、野生を守り育てるべきものとして真剣に見つめていて、フランス語、スペイン語、英語で歌われる10曲が、蜃気楼のように揺らめきながらダンスフロアを漂っていく。モノ湖やモンゴメリー峠に何世紀も生きてきた野生馬を守る活動に関わったことも、今作に大きな影響を与えているという。 アルバムの幕開けを飾るタイトル曲「Wildwife Wildlife」は、ラヴとダブが溶け合う、どこでもない場所から届いた多言語の便りのような一曲。取り締まられることのない狂おしい喜び、と Femme が語る自由な空気のなかで、Georis が引き出す彼女の歌声の奔放さと躍動感がそのまま息づいている。暗い時代にも踊りはある、暗い時代についても踊るのだ、というメッセージを体現するかのように、あわせて公開されたビデオとともに、その揺らめくグルーヴに身を任せてみたい。
